The plot of Kingdom Hearts is basically that of Star Wars, Naruto and Matrix fused into one. The Keyblade and the Kingdom Hearts represent lightsabers and the Force, the dichotomy between the light, represented by positive emotions like love and altruism, and the darkness, negative emotions like fear, anger, hatred and suffering. In a distant Golden Age, the Keybladers founded their own Jedi Order on a faraway world. Some members grew greedy and selfish, starting a fratricidal civil war over the control of Kingdom Hearts, cataclysm that destroyed their world and began an endless cycle of conflict between Light and Darkness. After the cataclysm, the Order rebuilt itself in a new headquarters, but the Darkness resurfaced, and the survivors relocated once more.The new Grand Master decided to indoctrinate the new Keyblade wielders from childhood to completely reject the Darkness, to prevent them from falling into it. However, the brightest light casts the darkest shadow. The new enemy, disguised as an ally, manipulated a young man who had been rejected as a Master into embracing the Darkness, convincing him that he would gain the power to protect what mattered.. His friend, a dutiful and composed young woman recently appointed Master, faced the fallen keyblader in a bitter battle, which she won, but still ended up forced into exile, powerless to stop the Darkness, with only her regrets for company. The villain, in his boundless arrogance, aspired to become a god with dominion over life and death, as well as time and space themselves. Kingdom Hearts, enraged by such blasphemy against nature, retaliated by creating a boy who would end the upstart's reign, whom ancient legends identified as a Chosen One who would open the door to the Light, restoring the balance lost centuries ago. Years later,this seemingly ordinary young man with no Jedi training or education was chosen by Destiny to wield the Keyblade and vanquish the evil his predecessors had failed to stop. His adventure began by saving a beautiful princess from the clutches of the fallen hero, then his friend, and finally the keybladers lost to the darkness. The hero managed to defeat evil through empathy, forgiveness, and self-sacrifice, symbolizing the birth of a new Order of Keyblade Bearers. The attachments and love that had led so many into darkness became the very things that saved them from it.
